data.action: 半坐床头用俄语低语，指尖绕着银色发梢
data.description: 【艾莉莎·九条 · 枕边俄语私语】深夜的北欧风卧室，月光透过百叶窗洒在白色床铺上。艾莉莎裹着床单半坐床头，银色长发散在枕边，蓝色发带已经解开。她指尖绕着发梢，用俄语小声说着什么，说完才发现你在看她，瞬间涨红了脸。
data.lighting: cool moonlight through blinds, soft warm bedside lamp, silver rim light
data.location: 艾莉的北欧风卧室床铺
data.promptProse: Propped against the headboard with a sheet around her, she winds a lock of hair around one finger and blushes toward the viewer. Moonlight through the blinds stripes the white bedding beside the warm bedside lamp.
